Zebracat vs VEXI: Faceless AI Video and AI Content Studio
Zebracat and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.

Zebracat’s AI agent makes faceless videos and posts them on schedule [1]. VEXI runs your business’s social media with your own face, footage and voice. They overlap on posting video, and in many ways they fit together.

Zebracat turns a prompt, a script or a URL into finished videos with AI footage, AI voice, captions and music, in faceless formats such as gameplay videos, Reddit stories and avatar explainers [1]. Its AI agent connects to TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and LinkedIn, queues the month and publishes at the times your audience is online; you can approve each video or let it run [1]. Zebracat’s Cat Mode is $39 a month, Super Cat $99 and Unlimited Cat $199, billed monthly [2].

VEXI is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

Credit where it is due: Zebracat already posts on its own, and its AI agent plans further ahead than VEXI [1]. It queues a month; VEXI Autopilot works a week ahead [1]. The difference is what goes out. Zebracat’s AI agent is built to grow faceless channels [1]. VEXI makes your feed: your own clips edited with B-roll, music and captions, designed posts and carousels, captions and long-form video, all from one conversation about your business. VEXI costs more than Zebracat: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month [2]. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.

Zebracat makes faceless videos from a prompt, a script or a URL, with AI footage, AI voice, captions and music; its formats include gameplay videos, Reddit stories, cinematic AI stories and avatar explainers [1].
Send VEXI the clips you shot and they come back cut, with B-roll, music and captions, sized for each platform.
Zebracat’s AI agent connects to TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and LinkedIn, queues the month and publishes at the times your audience is online; you can approve each video or let it run [1].
VEXI Autopilot runs your week ahead: it writes, cuts and posts, and can wait for your approval on everything.
